candidates.researchQuestion: When a digital-employee workflow launches detached work, what evidence should determine whether the parent workflow is actually terminal?
candidates.title: Foreground Completion Is Not Workflow Completion
candidates.title_zh: 前台完成，不等于工作流完成
candidates.coreProposition: Detached work must remain part of parent workflow terminal truth until it reaches a governed terminal state or its ownership is explicitly transferred; foreground return and static-graph completion are not sufficient terminal evidence.

sections.heading: The real defect is missing ownership accounting
sections.heading_zh: 真正的缺陷是缺少 Ownership Accounting

sections.heading: A terminal barrier needs an ownership-transfer rule
sections.heading_zh: Terminal Barrier 需要 Ownership-transfer Rule

sections.heading: Local task closure is not external-effect certainty
sections.heading_zh: Local Task Closure 不是 External-effect Certainty

evidenceClaims.claim: The merged ADK change waits for tracked in-flight detached dynamic work after static graph completion.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: 已合并 ADK 变更在 Static Graph Completion 后等待已跟踪的 In-flight Detached Dynamic Work。

evidenceClaims.claim: Raised exceptions, returned child errors and non-resumable detached interrupts can prevent clean parent success.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Raised Exception、返回的 Child Error 与不可 Resume 的 Detached Interrupt 可以阻止 Parent Clean Success。

evidenceClaims.claim: Foreground return is weaker terminal evidence than quiescence of all still-owned work.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Foreground Return 比全部 Still-owned Work 达到 Quiescence 更弱，不能作为同等 Terminal Evidence。

evidenceClaims.claim: Local lifecycle closure does not prove remote-effect completion, crash durability or exactly-once behavior.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Local Lifecycle Closure 不能证明 Remote-effect Completion、Crash Durability 或 Exactly-once Behavior。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general workflow-terminal accounting.

communityEdition.rationale: The complete Research Center edition already provides the transferable pattern; a separate community edition would repeat the same evidence.

candidates.researchQuestion: Where should authoritative permission and connected-tool state live when multiple app/runtime contexts coexist?
candidates.title: Permission Authority Belongs to the Attachment
candidates.coreProposition: Permission authority should follow the attachment/runtime lifecycle it governs: resolve and publish authority per server, reject unresolved authority, and let refresh replace only the owning scope rather than a broad shared manager.

sections.heading: Ambient execution context is not a safe authority source
sections.heading_zh: Ambient Execution Context 不是安全的 Authority Source

sections.heading: Preparation captures a lifecycle-specific authority snapshot
sections.heading_zh: Preparation 捕获 Lifecycle-specific Authority Snapshot

sections.heading: Scope ownership makes refresh blast radius auditable
sections.heading_zh: Scope Ownership 让 Refresh Blast Radius 可审计

sections.heading: A narrower owner is not a complete authorization proof
sections.heading_zh: 更窄的 Owner 不是完整 Authorization Proof

evidenceClaims.claim: Enabled MCP servers receive explicit published permission profiles derived from their attachment context.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Enabled MCP Server 获得从其 Attachment Context 解析的显式 Published Permission Profile。

evidenceClaims.claim: Unresolved server authority prevents MCP call preparation instead of falling back to ambient thread authority.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Unresolved Server Authority 会阻止 MCP Call Preparation，而不是回退到 Ambient Thread Authority。

evidenceClaims.claim: Permission-sensitive downstream paths consume the server-specific profile in the demonstrated runtime lifecycle.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Permission-sensitive 下游路径在已展示 Runtime Lifecycle 中消费 Server-specific Profile。

evidenceClaims.claim: Shared server identity does not justify shared mutable permission authority.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Shared Server Identity 不能证明 Shared Mutable Permission Authority 合理。

evidenceClaims.claim: Per-server authority snapshots do not prove distributed revocation or universal race freedom.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Per-server Authority Snapshot 不能证明 Distributed Revocation 或通用 Race Freedom。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general attachment-scoped authorization.

candidates.researchQuestion: How should a reusable client/runtime separate template HTTP configuration from per-invocation mutation without needlessly cloning heavyweight live client objects?
candidates.title: Copy the Options, Keep the Client
candidates.title_zh: 复制配置，不要复制客户端
candidates.coreProposition: Reusable runtimes should snapshot request-mutable option containers per invocation while intentionally preserving live clients by reference; this copy-on-mutation boundary avoids demonstrated aliasing and cloning failures without pretending to provide deep isolation.

sections.heading: Deep copy and raw sharing fail for different reasons
sections.heading_zh: Deep Copy 与 Raw Sharing 的失败原因不同

sections.heading: Mutation-specific copying makes the contract executable
sections.heading_zh: Mutation-specific Copying 让合同可执行

sections.heading: Tests must prove both separation and preservation
sections.heading_zh: 测试必须同时证明 Separation 与 Preservation

sections.heading: A copied dictionary is not deep isolation
sections.heading_zh: 复制 Dictionary 不等于 Deep Isolation

evidenceClaims.claim: The ADK helper creates new top-level request-mutable option containers per invocation.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: ADK Helper 为每次 Invocation 创建新的 Top-level Request-mutable Option Container。

evidenceClaims.claim: Retry options receive a separate model copy while a caller-supplied live HTTP client keeps the same identity.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Retry Option 获得独立 Model Copy，而 Caller 提供的 Live HTTP Client 保持相同 Identity。

evidenceClaims.claim: The request-preprocessing path uses the helper before processors and callbacks mutate invocation state.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Request-preprocessing Path 在 Processor 与 Callback 修改 Invocation State 前使用该 Helper。

evidenceClaims.claim: Copy policy should follow field ownership and mutation semantics rather than recursively copy an entire object graph.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Copy Policy 应跟随 Field Ownership 与 Mutation Semantics，而不是递归复制整个 Object Graph。

evidenceClaims.claim: Top-level copy-on-mutation does not isolate nested mutable values or state inside a shared client.
evidenceClaims.claim_zh: Top-level Copy-on-mutation 不能隔离 Nested Mutable Value 或 Shared Client 内部 State。

projectRelevance.rationale: The conclusion concerns general mutable request-state ownership.
